releaseScope: Review readiness for Phase 7 command schema examples and schema-only validation.

docsCompleteness.notes: Example records and changelog coverage are present for review.

schemaValidation.notes: Deterministic invariant checks confirm required fields, schema version and non-executable metadata.

safetyReview.notes: The checklist remains advisory and does not approve provider, runtime, dashboard, Git or deployment actions.

rollbackNotes.notes: Documentation and example records can be reverted through normal review if needed.

testExpectations.notes: The schema-only validator is expected to parse JSON and enforce deterministic invariants without external dependencies.

blockingIssues.description: Human review is pending before any downstream release decision.
